These public test keys are copied from RustCrypto ssh-key 0.7.0-rc.12 tests/examples, distributed under MIT OR Apache-2.0. The encrypted test key passphrase is `123`, as documented in its upstream private_key.rs tests. They are test vectors, never production credentials and not native PuTTY/MobaXterm export captures. Source: https://crates.io/crates/ssh-key/0.7.0-rc.12 . Their role is PPK conversion interoperability, with the converted OpenSSH key independently read by installed OpenSSH.
